name: Nour
pitch: medium, slightly deep and warm (not bass, not high)
delivery: relaxed, confident, charismatic; brisk but never rushed

browser_app.best: Microsoft Edge Multilingual neural voice (Brian Multilingual, then Andrew Multilingual): one speaker for English and French

desktop_local_phase5.goal: one consistent speaker in English and French, generated locally and offline
candidates: XTTS-v2: cross-lingual voice from one short reference clip (personal-use licence; check speed on the Intel CPU)
MeloTTS (EN + FR) with an OpenVoice V2 tone-colour converter applied to both, so both languages share one voice (MIT)
Piper: fastest on the Intel CPU, but each language is a different speaker, so it is the fallback only
desktop_local_phase5.reference_voice_rule: The reference clip must be a voice the user has the right to use: their own, a consenting person's, or a synthetic seed voice. Never a celebrity or other real person without consent.
